Question Choices: Select True or False. 0.6 x 0.5 = 0.3 ~~TRUE | FALSE~~
Solution: 0.6 = 6/10; 0.5 = 5/10. Multiply: 6 × 5 = 30; denominator 10 × 10 = 100. So 0.6 × 0.5 = 30/100 = 0.3. Therefore the requested answer is TRUE.
